Markets.title: US stocks today: US markets rebound from lows, but inflation, Iran war worries persist
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded, ending the day higher after a three-day selloff. However, investors remained cautious due to ongoing inflation, weak jobs data, and escalating tensions between the US and Iran.

Markets.title: Chevron expands Venezuela presence with $7 billion plan to double oil output in five years
Markets.summary: Chevron plans to invest more than $7 billion in Venezuela to double its oil production to roughly 600,000 barrels per day within five years. Following the announcement on Wednesday, Chevron's shares rose 0.51% to $212.13.

Markets.title: Prediction platform Kalshi targets US oil market with perpetual WTI contract
Markets.summary: Kalshi is seeking US regulatory approval to launch a 24/5 perpetual West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures contract. If approved, it would become the first oil-linked perpetual futures contract traded on a regulated US platform.

Markets.title: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel sees AI, power demand as new engines of growth
Markets.summary: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel views artificial intelligence and increased power demand from data centers as key drivers of future growth. Meanwhile, the company continues its strategic focus on Alphabet and Japanese trading houses while acknowledging ongoing consumer economic pressures.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities plunged nearly 1% before recovering due to US-Iran tensions, soaring crude prices, and global bond stress. The Sensex fell 374 points and the Nifty dropped 141 points, with analysts warning of continued bearishness below 24,000.

Markets.title: JM Financial Asset Management garners Rs 700 crore from maiden pre-IPO fund
Markets.summary: JM Financial Asset Management raised Rs 700 crore in the first close of its maiden pre-ipo fund. The fund will invest across sectors in companies planning to go public within 18 months.

Geo-Political.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia stated that an Iranian attack on a Saudi oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz killed two Filipino sailors. The kingdom condemned the targeting of the vessel, which was struck by projectiles on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish opposition parties are protesting Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's handling of the migrant crisis in Ceuta. Critics accuse the Prime Minister of abandoning the residents of the Spanish territory.

Geo-Political.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
Geo-Political.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airpo...

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin's veiled threat toward the UK is part of a broader campaign against the West. This strategy aims to keep Britain guessing and stressed regarding Moscow's true intentions.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
Geo-Political.summary: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial informed the judge for a second time in two days that they cannot reach a unanimous verdict. The jury remains deadlocked regarding the outcome of the case.

Geo-Political.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
Geo-Political.summary: A Maltese tycoon accused of orchestrating the 2017 car bomb assassination of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia has been acquitted. Caruana Galizia was killed after exposing high-level corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT for a specific query without paying for ads. This experiment highlights the shift from traditional SEO to AI-driven visibility (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace productivity. These widely used market solutions drive innovation and efficiency across multiple industry applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article explains that AI content generators are effective and engaging tools for creating audience-relevant material. However, it notes that choosing the right platform can be difficult due to the many options currently available on the market.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Centre defends GDP estimates, says revisions reflect updated data, methodology
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government defended its latest GDP estimates, denying allegations that it artificially inflated the June quarter's real and nominal growth rates. Officials stated that the revised figures are simply the result of updated data and methodology.

Data & Insights.title: BJP Vs Congress: ‘Not comparing apples with apples?’ Piyush Goyal hits back at Congress criticism of GDP numbers
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy grew faster than expected despite global economic concerns over the US-Iran war. In response to Congress's criticism of these latest GDP numbers, BJP leader Piyush Goyal defended the data.

Data & Insights.title: How a stalled mall in Srinagar fetched a massive amount in auction - more than double govt expectation
Data & Insights.summary: An auction for land located near Srinagar's Sangarmaal mall began on August 25 and concluded early the next morning. The property fetched a winning full-lease bid of ₹421.75 crore, which is more than double the government's expectation.

Data & Insights.title: '7.8% growth but still import-dependent': Sridhar Vembu explains Modi’s Swadeshi push
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted India's 7.8% real GDP growth in Q1 FY27 and urged citizens to consume local goods and avoid non-essential spending to conserve foreign exchange. Meanwhile, the RBI revised its FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7%, while Zoho CEO Sridhar Vembu emphasized that the nation remains import-dependent despite its economic expansion.

Data & Insights.title: Why a sovereign rating is not the last word on a nation’s creditworthiness
Data & Insights.summary: Sovereign credit ratings measure a country's ability to service its debt obligations rather than serving as a badge of national prestige. Analyzing the multiple dimensions of these ratings is more useful than treating them as the final word on a nation's creditworthiness.

Data & Insights.title: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay will be in UK from September 10 to 16 - What's on the agenda?
Data & Insights.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay will visit the United Kingdom from September 10 to 16 to engage with global manufacturing hubs. Additionally, a state delegation led by Minister Keerthana will travel to Taiwan on September 4 to attend the Semicon conference.

India.title: 2 Unidentified Gunmen Open Fire At Solan In Punjab's Mohali, Case Filed
India.summary: Two unidentified gunmen on a motorcycle opened fire outside a salon in Mohali, Punjab. A case has been filed regarding the incident, and police are investigating the shooting.

India.title: 3 Killed, Over 16,000 Evacuated As Flood Situation Worsens In UP
India.summary: Three people have died and over 16,000 residents have been evacuated due to worsening floods in Uttar Pradesh. Authorities rescued 3,042 of these individuals on Wednesday as severe flood conditions continued across parts of the state.

India.title: Ayodhya Ram Temple Gets Air Force Veteran As CEO, 3 New Members
India.summary: Retired Air Marshal Mishra has been appointed as the new CEO of the Ayodhya Ram Temple. He joins three other new members following his retirement from the Indian Air Force in May 2026.

India.title: Delhi High Court Fines Firm For Demoting Woman After Maternity Leave
India.summary: The Delhi High Court fined a firm for demoting a woman after she returned from maternity leave. The court ruled that women are ordinarily entitled to their exact previous positions after taking maternity leave.

India.title: 6 IAS Officers Among 19 Chargesheeted In Rs 504-Crore Scam In Haryana
India.summary: Haryana authorities have filed a chargesheet against 19 individuals, including six IAS officers and four bank officials, in connection with a Rs 504-crore scam. The latest legal action also targets nine other Haryana government officials involved in the financial irregularities.

India.title: Ex-Chief Economic Adviser Backs GDP Data, Calls Methodology "Cutting-Edge"
India.summary: Former Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy V Subramanian has defended India's GDP calculation methodology as cutting-edge. He also rejected opposition claims that the government intentionally manipulated previous economic data to artificially boost this year's growth figures.

General.title: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as borrowing costs surge
General.summary: During his first Prime Minister's Questions against Kemi Badenoch, Andy Burnham faced pressure over the economy as borrowing costs surged. The Prime Minister responded that his government would remain "grounded in fiscal responsibility."

General.title: Faisal Islam: Why bond market wildfire is keeping world leaders up at night
General.summary: Massive artificial intelligence investments and the ongoing conflict in Iran are increasing global borrowing costs. Consequently, turbulence in the international bond market is causing significant concern for world leaders.

General.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
General.summary: The British and French leaders will visit the British Museum to view the historic Bayeux Tapestry exhibition. King Charles has praised the upcoming display as unprecedented.

General.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
General.summary: Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, prompting accusations of growing recklessness. In response, the EU and NATO vowed to step up pressure on Russia following this new escalation.

General.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
General.summary: Spanish opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta.

General.title: ‘I'd be the last to know’: Stars of The Gentlemen react to Meghan reports
General.summary: The world premiere of the second season of Netflix's "The Gentlemen" took place in London on Wednesday night. At the event, the show's stars reacted to recent reports regarding Meghan Markle.
